ai_overview.answer_markdown:
If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Werribee**, there are several locksmiths that install and configure digital and keyless locks, including brands like Yale, Eufy, Samsung, Lockly, and Aqara.

Some well-reviewed options include:

- Citywest Locksmiths – Werribee-based, 24/7 service, installs digital and smart locks, and can also advise on the right lock for your door. Their website specifically mentions keyless and digital lock installation. [citywestlocksmiths.com.au](https://citywestlocksmiths.com.au/digital-lock-installation-keyless-entry-keyless-locks/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Sentry Locksmiths – Highly rated local locksmith offering residential and commercial lock services.
- Unique Locksmith – Mobile locksmith servicing Melbourne's west with strong customer reviews.
- WILLI LOCKSMITH LANDING – Serves the Werribee/Williams Landing area and offers extended daily hours.

Typical installation costs in the Werribee/Melbourne area are:
- **Straight replacement** (existing deadbolt): around **A$150–A$250** for labour.
- **New smart lock requiring drilling or door modifications:** around **A$250–A$450+**, depending on the door and lock model. [www.airtasker.com](https://www.airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/werribee-vic/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you already have a smart lock, the installer will usually:
- Remove the existing lock.
- Fit and align the new smart lock.
- Configure the keypad/app.
- Test locking, unlocking, and emergency access.
- Show you how to use the system.

If you haven't purchased a lock yet, tell me:
- **Your door type** (timber, aluminium, security screen, etc.).
- **The smart lock brand/model** you're considering (or your budget).

I can recommend compatible locks and estimate the total installed cost.
